items.t: Is Vodafone Group (LSE:VOD) A Bargain As Citi Flags Germany Risks?
items.sum: Citi Research’s downgrade of Vodafone Group (LSE:VOD) to sell put Germany in the spotlight, with concerns focused on revenue pressure, core earnings weakness and future debt tied to its German fibre joint venture. Vodafone Group’s share price has slid over the past month, with a 30 day share price return down 12.94% and a 7 day move down 11.48% that lines up with the reaction to Citi’s downgrade.

items.t: Citi turns bearish on Vodafone as German telecom outlook deteriorates
items.sum: Investing.com -- Citi Research on Monday downgraded Vodafone Group (LON:VOD) to "sell" from "neutral" and cut its price target to 100 pence from 127 pence, citing expectations of a decline in German fixed and mobile service revenue in the second half and a steeper fall in core earnings in the country.

items.t: Australian Defensive Stocks With Pricing Power As Inflation Stays Higher For Longer
